title: Barnet Emergency Help Points
summary: Key emergency medical facilities, urgent walk-in centres, local hazards, and supply points across Barnet.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals
- Barnet Hospital: Wellhouse Lane, Barnet EN5 3DJ. From High Barnet station: ~25 min walk west along Wood Street and Wellhouse Lane (~1.2 miles), or take bus 107 or 263 west (~8 mins).
- Royal Free Hospital: Pond Street, Hampstead NW3 2QG. From Golders Green station: take bus 268 south-east along North End Road (~20 mins), or bus 210 towards Finsbury Park.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres
- Finchley Memorial Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Granville Road, Finchley N12 0JE. From Finchley Central station: ~20 min walk north-east via Ballards Lane and Granville Road, or take bus 460 (~10 mins).
- Edgware Community Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Burnt Oak Broadway, Edgware HA8 0AD. From Burnt Oak station: ~10 min walk north along Burnt Oak Broadway (~0.5 miles), or take bus 32, 142, or 204.

3. Local Hazards
- Surface water flood risks concentrate around the Dollis Brook corridor running through Finchley and Mill Hill, and the Silk Stream catchment across Edgware and Hendon.

4. Essential Supplies
- Large supermarkets and pharmacies on Barnet High Street (EN5), Ballards Lane (N12), Golders Green Road (NW11), and Brent Street (NW4) provide emergency bottled water and medical supplies.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
